sources.title: How to Use the Ban Command in Minecraft
How to Use the Pardon Command in Minecraft
How to Use the List Command in Minecraft (Java: /list [uuids])

notes: Vanilla Mojang server.jar. minecraft.wiki/w/RCON calls it 'an implementation of the Source RCON protocol' and documents the Type 2 command payload as bare text ('time set 0'), so commands are sent WITHOUT a leading slash; the same is true on the interactive stdin console, which is the fallback when RCON is off. RCON is OFF by default (enable-rcon=false) and refuses to start with a blank rcon.password. Moderation is by username (game profile): /ban takes <targets> of type game_profile and digminecraft gives '/ban <name> [reason ...]' and '/pardon <name>', so playerId.label is Username. Vanilla has NO temporary/duration ban - the wiki syntax is 'ban <targets> [<reason>]' with no duration argument - so {duration} is deliberately absent; a temp ban needs a plugin. There is no motd command; motd is only a server.properties key. 'list' output is ONE line for all players, e.g. 'There are 2 of a max of 20 players online: Notch (069a79f4-44e9-4726-a5be-fca90e38aaf5), Jeb_ (853c80ef-3c37-49fd-aa49-938b674adae6)', matching MCDReforged's '^There are (\d+) of a max( of)? (\d+) players online:(.*)$' - the parser must scan that line globally, not assume one player per line. The linePattern is uuid-anchored so it cannot mis-match the header text. 'list uuids' is vanilla-only: Bukkit/Spigot/Paper substitute their own /list which does not support the uuids argument (it is ignored, or errors depending on build), in which case send plain 'list' and take names only - the linePattern will then match nothing. Bans are also written to banned-players.json (name + uuid) and banned-ips.json in the server root; pardon is the live unban. SOURCE CAVEAT: mcipc's RCON page corroborates that a Minecraft server speaks RCON and that commands carry no slash, but it does NOT itself say 'Source' - the Source flavour and port 25575 come from minecraft.wiki. Re-verified 2026-09-13 against the wiki RCON/server.properties/ban/kick/list/say pages, digminecraft ban/pardon/list, mcipc and MCDReforged; no disagreement found.
